provenance.geometry_interpretation: The photographed foreground is the local algae-covered erosion-groove field around the researched Camera Zone, so B131 reuses the curated 250 m small-area extent as a conservative full-circle subject envelope. For the catalog's March-to-mid-May dawn contract, geometric sunrise azimuth is approximately 69°–99° at this latitude; B131 pads that to 65°–105° and 0–15 km for atmospheric WeatherGrid coverage. This does not claim an exact reef polygon, exact local horizon, or terrestrial Sun coordinate.
